text:
marco: Quick consolidation from the token validation postmortem. Root cause summary: external signing key rotated out by vendor + permission canary not enabled in two regions = auth calls falling back to unsigned paths. Audit payloads omitted user_id on /token/issue and /token/refresh. Posting action owners and short ETAs.

tegan: I'll take the permission-canary + predeploy smoke tests. Plan: 3 pytest checks + Datadog metric. ETA 2026-03-30. Adding tracker card now.

natalie: I'll own key-rotation automation and KMS role update. Will add a GitHub Actions dry-run and a runbook snippet. ETA for dry-run logs: 2026-03-27. Need security review for iam:Decrypt change.

ops: On-prem maintenance window: 2026-04-09 02:00-05:00 UTC. Managed customers will get notice 2026-04-02. Air-gapped installs require manual scheduling.

sec: Please attach IAM policy diff to tracker card for approval. Also request that rotation keeps previous key active for 48h staged swap.

marco: Proposed Datadog query for detecting missing user_id post-deploy:

```
logs("service:auth AND http.path:/token/* AND !user_id").rollup("count").last("10m") > 5
```

pager-bot: Reminder: action owners must ack in 24h. Tracker: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2112. Auto-remind in 48h.

tegan: added playbook snippet: if canary fires pre-deploy -> block rollout; if post-deploy -> page oncall, run rotate-keys --rollback if rotation failure confirmed.

natalie: rotation plan = monthly scheduled rotate, staged swap with both keys valid 48h, command example: `./scripts/rotate-keys --staged --verify`. Will document rollback steps in runbook.

marco: Checklist copied to tracker: - [ ] GH workflow + dry-run (natalie) - [ ] IAM policy diff + sec approval (natalie + sec) - [ ] Permission canary + tests (tegan) - [ ] Audit events emit user_id/request_id (marco -> will coordinate) - [ ] Playbook/runbook updates (natalie + tegan) - [ ] Customer notice for on-prem (ops)

tegan: ack.

natalie: ack. pinging @sec for quick review.

marco: Next sync Thu 09:00 to surface blockers. Leaving this thread open for status updates. :calendar:
